sloka: सुग्रीव प्रिय कामार्थम् प्राप्तौ तत्र दुरासदौ ।स ते भ्रातुर् हि विख्यातः सहायो रण कर्मणि ॥४-१५-१८॥
transliteration: sugrīva priya kāmārtham prāptau tatra durāsadau ।sa te bhrātur hi vikhyātaḥ sahāyo raṇa karmaṇi ॥4-15-18॥

translations.english: 'Rama, famous for crushing foes in war, like the fire that breaks out at the dissolution of the world, has slain strong enemies like Khara and will help your brother.
translations.hindi: सुम्रांव भी मूका तान ओर अत्यन्त क्रद्ध हो सोने का हार आरण किए हुए वालि के समीप गए
